svg.data-weight: 6.7 kg with no power supply, fan module or extension module (EX4400-24X and -24X-AFI); 6.65 kg for the -DC builds
svg.data-depth-with-modules: 430.0 mm with power supply and fan modules; 440.7 mm with an extension module as well
svg.data-mounting: two-post kit EX-RMK in the box; four-post kit EX-4PST-RMK and wall kit EX-WMK separate
svg.data-heat-dissipation: 422.84 BTU/hr idle and 470.58 at 100 percent traffic with a 550 W AC supply; 463.76 and 497.86 with a 550 W DC supply
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 C to 45 C (32 F to 113 F)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 C to 70 C (-40 F to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation up to 1828.8 m (6000 ft) at 40 C
svg.data-acoustic-noise: 42.71 dB(A) typical with one 550 W AC supply and front-to-back airflow (Table 115)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches; the front QSFP28 ports are Virtual Chassis ports only after request virtual-chassis mode hgoe
svg.data-macsec: AES-256 on all SFP and SFP+ network ports, on the native QSFP28 ports and on the extension module ports
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10 GbE SFP+ and 1 GbE SFP transceivers; the exact list is in the Hardware Compatibility Tool
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: The two front ports take 100GbE QSFP28 or 40GbE QSFP+ transceivers (40G from Junos OS 22.1R1). Breakout cables give 4x25G and 4x10G. The exact list is in the Hardware Compatibility Tool
svg.data-extension-slot: one slot for the EX4400-EM-4S, EX4400-EM-4Y or EX4400-EM-1C module
svg.data-console: USB-C and RJ-45 (CON), both on the front
svg.data-oob: MGMT RJ-45 on the front, 10/100/1000, with link activity and status lamps
svg.data-cloud: Juniper Mist Wired Assurance, and the Junos CLI and J-Web
svg.data-seismic: Tested for Zone 4 earthquake according to NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 5

g.data-description: the rear two-hole protective earthing terminal
g.title: ground-mark

g.data-input-connector: D-sub 3W3 - -48 VDC input (-), return (+) and ground
g.data-input-voltage: -48 VDC to -60 VDC rated operating voltage
g.title: psu-0--module
